name: Kami-chan
source:
The god of this world, and the very one who summoned the protagonist group here.
She prefers to be called "God-chan" rather than "God" or whatever—somehow acts like you're buddies.
She is the type who won't leave you alone, possessing people's bodies (usually [url=/c131386]Nozomi-sensei[/url]'s) to meddle in everything, yet never says anything useful.
Tread carefully—she nags endlessly.

[Translated from [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/hajiron/character/chara08.php]official website[/url]]
